statement: Independent GL-free diagnostic codecs serialize linear albedo, signed view normals, raw hardware depth and integral material IDs as little-endian PFM, exact RGBA32UI draw/mesh/LOD/ownership/pass identities as a versioned binary image, and schema-1 top-left JSON point probes. Exact sizes, bounded dimensions and identity/material metadata are validated before stream writes; nonfinite floating samples survive in AOVs and become explicit null channels in probes. Registered regressions cover encoding, orientation, invalid input, nonfinite values and partial stream failures.
